name: read_file
description: Read file by line range (1-indexed) or entire file. LARGE FILE PROTECTION: (1) Files > 500MB — refused, use grep first. (2) Files > 10MB — should_read_entire_file=true blocked, use line ranges. (3) Entire reads capped at 1000 lines / 10KB (excess truncated, truncated=true). (4) Files > 2MB trigger warning. Response: content, lines, file_size_bytes, total_lines, truncated, warning, read_mode; range reads also add start_line, end_line, lines_before_range, lines_after_range. ALWAYS check file_size_bytes and total_lines before further reads. Max 1000 lines/call for range reads. should_read_entire_file=true only for files < 2MB, < 1000 lines. For large files, use start_line_one_indexed + end_line_one_indexed_inclusive to paginate. If truncated=true, read remaining with line ranges.

target_file.description: File path to read (relative or absolute).

start_line_one_indexed.description: 1-indexed start line (inclusive). Required when should_read_entire_file=false. Default: 1.

end_line_one_indexed_inclusive.description: 1-indexed end line (inclusive). Max 1000 lines from start_line. Required when should_read_entire_file=false. Default: start_line + 999.

should_read_entire_file.description: Read entire file. BLOCKED for > 10MB files. Capped at 1000 lines / 10KB. Only for < 2MB, < 1000 line files. Default: false.

explanation.description: Why this tool is used and how it contributes to the goal.

name: search_replace_in_file
description:
Replace text in a file. Provide file_path (absolute), old_string (exact match), and new_string. For moves/renames, use run_bash with mv.

CRITICAL: old_string must be unique — include 3-5 lines of context. One replacement per call; use multiple calls for multiple changes. To create a new file, use empty old_string with full content as new_string.

Verify with read_file before editing. Absolute paths only.

old_string.description: Exact text to replace (must be unique in file and match contents exactly, including whitespace and indentation).

description: Create a new file at the specified path with given content. Fails if the file already exists.
name: create_file

target_file.description: File path to create (relative or absolute; absolute paths are preserved as-is).

content.description: Content to write to the new file.

name: run_bash
description:
Execute a bash command. Use is_dangerous=true for commands affecting anything beyond the workspace (system packages, services, network, sudo). Use is_dangerous=false only for workspace operations (build, lint, test, git). Use is_background=true for long-running commands.

Guidelines: use absolute paths, chain with && for sequential execution, avoid newlines, append | cat for paged output. Dangerous commands require user authorization.

explanation.description: Why this command is needed and how it contributes to the goal.

is_background.description: Run the command in the background.

is_dangerous.description: Whether the command affects anything beyond the project workspace (files outside project, system config, running processes, installed packages, network settings, dotfiles/shell config). When in doubt, set to true.

name: thinking
description: Cognitive tool for self-correction and deep analysis. Use IMMEDIATELY when an action fails, an error occurs, or you're unsure. Do NOT use to execute actions (write files, run commands). Instead, generate a 'Chain of Thought' log: 1. Analyze root cause. 2. Brainstorm 2-3 solutions with pros/cons. 3. Select best solution. Avoids blind retries and infinite loops.

problem_description.description: Error message, failure description, or problem to solve.

current_action.description: Action attempted and failed, or current context.

observation.description: Additional context, observations, or what happened.

name: micro_agent
description: Isolated LLM inference call with a custom system prompt. Use for reasoning, analysis, or generation that benefits from a fresh context. Typical uses: deep code/error analysis, structured output (JSON, summaries, translations), self-reflection. Returns raw text.

system_prompt.description: System prompt defining role, rules, and output format for this LLM inference.

task.description: Task description, question, or content to process.

name: deepthinking
description: Deep system analysis for complex problems. Multi-dimensional analysis (root cause, system impact, constraints, solution architecture) via isolated LLM call. Use ONLY when: 1) conventional methods (thinking, micro_agent, repo analysis, sub-agent delegation) have failed, 2) the problem requires systematic design, or 3) multiple failures indicate fundamental misunderstanding. Skip for simple issues. Input: context (problem context, errors, constraints, what was tried) and goal (specific objective).

context.description: Complete problem context: execution feedback, key errors, problem background, constraints, what was tried and failed, and any other relevant info for deep analysis.

goal.description: Specific objective. What should the deep analysis produce? A solution design, debugging strategy, architectural decision, or comprehensive plan.

name: delete_file
description: Delete files (multiple in one call). Must ensure files exist before deleting.

name: rename_file
description: Move or rename an existing file.

name: list_dir
description: View files in the specified directory.

name: print_dir_tree
description: Print directory tree. Auto-ignores common build artifacts, cache dirs, dependency folders, compiled files. show_files=false for directory-only overview (with file counts). Output truncated per-directory when exceeding max_items. Depth hard-capped at 2 levels.

dir_path.description: Directory path to print tree for.

max_depth.description: Max depth to traverse. Hard-capped at 2 (values > 2 clamped). Depth 0 shows only root name. Default: 2

show_files.description: Show individual files (true) or only directories (false). When false, file counts shown per directory. Default: true

max_items.description: Max items to display per directory. Extra items truncated with a count. Default: 50

ignore_extra.description: Additional dirs to ignore (merged with built-in defaults). Useful for project-specific noise.

name: search_by_regex
description: High-performance search via ripgrep (rg) for large codebases. Supports PCRE2 regex and respects .gitignore. Locate function definitions, variable references, error messages, or complex code patterns across files.

name: semantic_search
description: Semantic search for relevant code snippets via natural language query or code snippet. Returns matches with file paths, symbol names, and code blocks. Use when you need specific functionality/implementation details but don't know the exact file or function name.

query.description: Natural language query or code snippet to search for.

name: query_code_skeleton
description: Get skeleton (function/class definitions without implementation) of specific files. Use to understand structure without reading full content.

filepaths.description: Absolute file paths to query skeletons for.

name: query_code_snippet
description: Get code snippet of a specific function in a file. Use when you need to read the function's implementation.

name: ask_user_for_help
description: Use when you need user input, confirmation, or selection. Pauses execution until user responds. Three modes: confirm (yes/no), select (choose from options), input (free text). Mode auto-inferred from suggested_options or set via interaction_type.

reason.description: Why you're stuck and need user help/authorization.

specific_question.description: Specific question to ask the user (shown directly to user).

suggested_options.description: Optional answer options for the user. Controls interaction mode: empty → input (free text), two boolean-like options (e.g., ['yes', 'no']) → confirm (yes/no), 2+ non-boolean options → select (option list).

interaction_type.description: Explicitly set interaction mode (overrides auto-inference from suggested_options). 'confirm' → yes/no buttons, 'select' → option list, 'input' → free text.

default_value.description: Optional default option (confirm/select) or pre-filled text (input).

placeholder.description: Placeholder text in input field (input mode only).

allow_custom.description: Allow custom input in select mode. Default: true. Set false to restrict to suggested options only.

name: agent_exit
description: Exit the agent with a reason. Use when done — task completed, failed, needs clarification, or must terminate. Reason must explain WHY.

reason.description: Reason for exiting, e.g., task completed, cannot proceed, blocked by missing info, or must terminate.

name: delegate_browser
description: Delegate web research to Browser-Agent. Use ONLY when info CANNOT be obtained from local docs (go docs, python docs, help, man, --help). Browser-Agent navigates the web and returns findings. Provide a clear, self-contained task description.

task.description: Clear, self-contained research task, e.g., 'Search for the latest docs on Python's asyncio.run' or 'Find solutions for Go error: undefined: sql.NullString'.

name: find_function_callee
description: Find all functions a specified function calls (its callees). Returns invoked functions with file paths and line numbers. Understands what a function does internally.

function_name.description: Function name to find callees for.

filepath.description: Optional file path to narrow search (e.g., 'src/main.go').

name: find_function_caller
description: Find all functions that call a specified function (its callers). Returns invoking functions with file paths and line numbers. Understands who depends on this function.

function_name.description: Function name to find callers for.

filepath.description: Optional file path to narrow search (e.g., 'src/main.go').

name: query_call_graph
description: Query function call graph with configurable depth. Shows callers (upstream) and callees (downstream) around a center function. Depth = layers of callers/callees (max 3). Understands the full calling context.

function_name.description: Function name to query as the center of the call graph.

depth.description: Layers of callers/callees to include (1-3, default: 1).

name: git_checkpoint_list
description: List all git checkpoints for the current session. See available rollback points. Each represents a saved codebase state to return to if something goes wrong.

name: git_checkpoint_rollback
description: Roll back working tree to a specific checkpoint. WARNING: discards all changes AFTER the checkpoint. Use git_checkpoint_list first. checkpoint_tag must be the full tag name from the list.

checkpoint_tag.description: Tag name of checkpoint to roll back to (from git_checkpoint_list).

name: git_checkpoint_create
description: Manually create a git checkpoint at the current state. Use before risky operations (large refactors, complex merges, experimental changes). Allows rollback if something goes wrong.

message.description: Why this checkpoint is being created.

name: consolidate_knowledge
description: Consolidate key knowledge from the current task into the knowledge base. Type and source auto-tagged by the system. Suitable for: (1) distilling domain knowledge after code analysis; (2) recording key change decisions after modifications; (3) capturing architecture patterns or design rules. Content ≤1500 chars, at least 1 tag required.

content.description: Knowledge content (≤1500 chars). Keep file paths, function names, and symbol names.

name: prune_history
description: Maintain knowledge base health: list entries, merge similar entries, or delete stale entries by ID. Run merge periodically to deduplicate.

action.description: Operation type: list=List entries, merge=Merge similar entries, delete=Delete by ID

limit.description: Max entries to read for list/merge (default: 50).

ids.description: List of entry IDs to delete (required for delete).

name: TodoWrite
description: Write and manage the structured task list. FULL REPLACEMENT semantics: every call must provide the complete list; items not listed are treated as deleted; an empty array clears the list. When to call: when a multi-step task starts (plan the steps), when a single step completes (mark completed, promote the next), or when new work is discovered (add items). Each item requires: content (the task description in imperative form), active_form (the present continuous form shown while the item is in_progress, e.g. 'Running tests'), and status (pending | in_progress | completed). Constraints: at most one item can be in_progress; at most 25 items; content/active_form must be non-empty. Keep content self-describing so progress remains recoverable after context resets.

content.description: The task description in imperative form (required).

active_form.description: The present continuous form shown while the item is in_progress (required).

todos.description: The FULL replacement task list. Provide the complete list on every call; items not listed are treated as deleted; an empty array clears the list.
